latest_agent_session_id.title: Latest Agent Session Id
latest_agent_session_id.description: The latest-run harness's agentSessionId; a fast-path mirror of harness_sessions[<latest harness>].agent_session_id.

latest_turn_index.title: Latest Turn Index
latest_turn_index.description: Conversation-level turn counter compared against each harness's turn_index.

agent_session_id.title: Agent Session Id
agent_session_id.description: This harness's own agentSessionId, fed to session/load on resume.

turn_index.title: Turn Index
turn_index.description: Conversation turn number this harness last ran at. Load-eligible only when equal to the conversation's latest_turn_index; otherwise this harness's session file is stale (another harness ran since).

additionalProperties.title: HarnessSessionRecord
additionalProperties.description: Per-harness resume state. Value shape of `data.harness_sessions[<harness>]`.

harness_sessions.title: Harness Sessions
harness_sessions.description: Per-harness resume state, keyed by harness id (e.g. 'claude', 'pi'). Durable mirror of the staleness guard.

anyOf.title: SessionStateData
anyOf.description:
Typed shape of the `data` column: the session's durable continuity state.

Stored in the existing `data` JSON column (no dedicated columns) — every field is
read and compared in the runner, never queried server-side, so a typed DTO gives the
contract without a schema change.

data.description: Durable continuity state (resume ids + staleness guard).

sandbox_id.title: Sandbox Id
sandbox_id.description: Remote sandbox id — the single source of truth resume pointer.
